summary: The jointly feasible symmetric bridge-tilt grid executed for fixed and rebuilt treatment labels under pooled and family-month models. Thirty-one eligible split sources account for 14.86 percent of supported early routed stock. Across K=0.25 to 4, pooled coefficients range from -0.1446 to -0.1163 and family-month coefficients from -0.0783 to 0.0439; endpoint paired occupation-clustered intervals versus K=1 contain zero. The correct interpretation is that the design does not detect those endpoint differences, not economic equivalence.
